name: search
description: Search the Trove collection by keyword. Returns matching items with ids (pass an id to work), titles, creators/sources, dates and links. Requires your own free Trove API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own Trove API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at trove.nla.gov.au: create an account, then Create an API key.

name: work
description: Fetch full details for one Trove item by id — a Trove work id (from search). Requires your own free Trove API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own Trove API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free at trove.nla.gov.au: create an account, then Create an API key.
